name: BLAST
text: When making a hit roll with this weapon, for each roll of 6, allocate 2 damage points to another visible fighter within 1" of the target of the attack action.

name: BRACE
text: When determining how many ranged weapons a fighter is equipped with, two weapons with this special rule count as one.

name: MIGHTY 1
text: When a fighter makes an attack action with this weapon, increase their Fight characteristic by 1 if it is a melee weapon, or their Shoot characteristic by 1 if it is a ranged weapon.

name: MIGHTY 2
text: When a fighter makes an attack action with this weapon, increase their Fight characteristic by 2 if it is a melee weapon, or their Shoot characteristic by 2 if it is a ranged weapon.

name: ONE-USE
text: This weapon can only be used for one attack action each battle.

name: PARRY
text: When a fighter armed with this weapon is the target of a melee attack action, increase its Defense characteristic by 1.

name: RELOAD
text: This weapon must be reloaded after being used for an attack action. A fighter can reload one of their weapons with this special rule when making the wait action.

name: TWO HANDED
text: This weapon counts as two hand weapons for the sake of equipment restrictions.

name: UNRELIABLE
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, if any hit rolls result in a 1, all hit rolls are discarded and the attack action ends.
